title: PatchPilot PHP advisory assessment test cases
scope: The current implementation dynamically researches PHP sources. Expected assessment outcomes below are conditional on authoritative advisory data being returned and normalized; the application does not hard-code these CVEs.

cases.scenario: Backend health endpoint
cases.expected: HTTP 200 JSON with ok=true, service=PatchPilot AI, and tinyfishKeyConfigured reflecting server configuration.
cases.coverage: Executed against a local backend with a non-secret placeholder key; HTTP 200 and configured=true were returned.

cases.scenario: Valid multi-asset scan covering Windows, Linux, and Unknown platforms

input.provider: Synthetic official-domain advisory fixture; TinyFish Search/Fetch is stubbed locally

cases.expected: HTTP 200 report with one finding per asset: Windows POTENTIALLY_AFFECTED when build matches; Linux NOT_APPLICABLE to an explicitly Windows-only advisory; Unknown platform NEEDS_REVIEW.
cases.coverage: Executed through the local /api/scan endpoint with stubbed provider Search/Fetch responses. Synthetic test fixture only; no external TinyFish calls.

cases.scenario: Empty inventory
cases.expected: HTTP 400 with a JSON inventory validation error.
cases.coverage: Executed locally with a non-secret placeholder key; rejected before provider access.

cases.scenario: Missing assets property
cases.expected: HTTP 400 with a JSON inventory validation error.
cases.coverage: Executed locally with a non-secret placeholder key; rejected before provider access.

cases.scenario: Inventory asset missing required version
cases.expected: HTTP 400 with a required name, product, and version validation error.
cases.coverage: Executed locally with a non-secret placeholder key; rejected before provider access.

cases.scenario: Unsupported operating system value
cases.expected: HTTP 400 with supported operating-system values; do not silently coerce invalid platform values to Unknown.
cases.coverage: Executed locally with a non-secret placeholder key; HTTP 400 validation response received.

cases.scenario: TinyFish Search returns an upstream HTTP error
cases.expected: HTTP 502 JSON error with TINYFISH_HTTP_ERROR; no success-shaped report.
cases.coverage: Executed through the local API with a stubbed TinyFish response; no external provider request.

cases.scenario: TinyFish Search request times out
cases.expected: HTTP 504 JSON error with TINYFISH_REQUEST_TIMEOUT; no success-shaped report.
cases.coverage: Executed through the local API with a stubbed timeout; no external provider request.

cases.scenario: TinyFish Search returns malformed JSON
cases.expected: HTTP 502 JSON error with TINYFISH_INVALID_RESPONSE; no success-shaped report.
cases.coverage: Executed through the local API with a stubbed malformed response; no external provider request.

cases.scenario: PHP 8.3.35, before the verified 8.3.36 fixed threshold for both known CVEs
cases.expected: POTENTIALLY_AFFECTED for each advisory when each CVE is represented and its evidence is verified.
cases.coverage: Existing assessment helper; actual helper probe executed. End-to-end live scan is not verified without TinyFish credentials.

cases.scenario: PHP 8.3.36, meets the verified fixed threshold for both known CVEs
cases.expected: FIXED_FOR_THIS_CVE for each verified advisory, not a claim that PHP 8.3.36 is free of all vulnerabilities.
cases.coverage: Existing assessment helper; actual helper probe executed. Live advisory discovery is not verified.

cases.scenario: PHP 8.3.34 is older than the fixed threshold and needs assessment
cases.expected: POTENTIALLY_AFFECTED for each verified advisory; the assessment remains conditional on package and platform evidence.
cases.coverage: Existing assessment helper; actual helper probe executed.

cases.scenario: PHP 8.3.37 is newer than the fixed threshold
cases.expected: FIXED_FOR_THIS_CVE for each verified advisory, not a general security conclusion.
cases.coverage: Existing assessment helper; actual helper probe executed.

cases.scenario: Unknown or malformed installed version
cases.expected: NEEDS_REVIEW; do not infer affected or fixed status from an unparsable version.
cases.coverage: Existing assessment helper returns NEEDS_REVIEW when advisory data reaches assessment. The current scan endpoint instead returns PHP_VERSION_BRANCH_MISSING if no PHP branch can be parsed; this endpoint behavior was executed and does not meet the desired NEEDS_REVIEW outcome.

cases.scenario: Submit a PHP asset with an unknown version to the scan endpoint
cases.expected: Proposed future behavior: HTTP 200 report with NEEDS_REVIEW for the asset, or a documented client validation response; do not attempt a live branch search with no parseable version.
cases.coverage: Existing endpoint was executed with a local placeholder key; it currently responds HTTP 502 with code PHP_VERSION_BRANCH_MISSING. This is an observed gap, not a passing test.

cases.scenario: Advisory text explicitly limits applicability to Windows or a specific Windows build

advisory.buildRestrictions: Windows x64 Thread Safe builds only

cases.expected: NEEDS_REVIEW until OS and any required build details are verified. A verified Linux/macOS asset is NOT_APPLICABLE only when the advisory is explicitly Windows-only.
cases.coverage: The assessment helper and API platform matrix were executed. The Windows restriction is synthetic and overrides the advisory fields for test purposes; neither known CVE is claimed to be Windows-only.

cases.scenario: One advisory source contains multiple CVE identifiers

input.sourcePageText: Synthetic parser fixture with CVE-2026-109618 on one line and CVE-2026-109619 on the next.

cases.expected: Preserve both unique CVE IDs and assess each CVE independently. Never assume that a multi-CVE advisory has one shared range unless the source confirms it.
cases.coverage: Synthetic multi-ID page parsing is exercised by a dependency-injected TinyFish test; it does not claim that either official advisory combines the two CVEs.

cases.scenario: Advisory has no verified fixed version
cases.expected: NEEDS_REVIEW; do not guess a patch version or fabricate remediation.
cases.coverage: Existing assessment helper; actual helper probe executed.

cases.scenario: Empty or omitted inventory
cases.expected: HTTP 400 with an inventory validation error; no scan is launched.
cases.coverage: Existing API validation; empty and omitted inventory requests were executed with a local placeholder key.

cases.scenario: TinyFish API failure or timeout
cases.expected: Return an explicit upstream error; map timeouts to HTTP 504 and other research errors to HTTP 502. Do not return a success-shaped empty scan.
cases.coverage: Existing dependency-injected TinyFish unit tests cover provider HTTP errors, timeouts, redaction, and malformed JSON handling. A real external TinyFish outage was not induced.
